why: New lower bounds on the longest induced path (snake) length were published for dimensions 9-13: Ace (2025) reported 732/1439/2854 in dims 11/12/13, and a July 2026 'Census of New Snake-in-the-Box Records' (arXiv 2607.15270) reports improved bounds of 191/379/746/1476/2924 in dims 9-13, directly improving the problem's own quantity.
